title: 8 – DESIGN AND CONSTRUCTION OF EQUIPMENT
officialText:
8.5.2 After the words "shall have" insert the words "manual and."

8.8 Add the following to the end of this paragraph: "Also include the horsepower of the prime mover or compressor, or the equivalent of such horsepower in kilowatts."
